note: The IFC and Arab Monetary Fund's Arab Credit Reporting Guide (2015) on the Palestine Monetary Authority's credit registry: information is shared monthly, with no threshold, written as 30 days, and a report shows the last three years' monthly payment history, written as three years; registered as secondary, the PMA's own instructions not read.

sources.title: IFC and Arab Monetary Fund, Arab Credit Reporting Guide (2015)
sources.said: payment performance data (including a monthly payment ... history of the last three years). Negative and positive ... information, without any threshold limit, is shared. All ... information is shared on a monthly basis
